caption:
Think you only get a calculator on half the SAT math?

That's a myth. Calculators are allowed on the entire Math section, Desmos is built into Bluebook, and you can bring an acceptable calculator too.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Think you only get a calculator on half the SAT math? Myth.

youtube.title: SAT Myth: There's a No-Calculator Section
youtube.description: Calculators are allowed on the entire digital SAT Math section, with the Desmos graphing calculator built into Bluebook.
